science.qualification: Photosphere color from the star's measured spectrum (Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 612), dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 8,694 K and log g 3.94 (u1 0.299, u2 0.312): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting. The surface is darkened by latitude from the published Roche-von Zeipel fit of Jones et al. (2015), ApJ 813, 58: the hot poles brighter and bluer, the cool equator dimmer and redder.

offLimbContext.source: none: no observation, a transparent plate

limbMaterial.composition: black alpha darkens the photosphere according to the selected quadratic limb-darkening law; transparent outside the silhouette
